title: Public applicant submits a complete KYC registration
description: Verifies that a public applicant can submit a full registration with valid identity documents and receive a successful completion state.

steps.description: Navigate to /users/check-vehicle
Fill in a vehicle registration number that is not yet registered
Submit the availability check
Proceed to the registration form
Fill in the applicant name field with a valid full name
Fill in the vehicle registration number field with the same available vehicle registration number
Upload a valid PDF or image document for the KYC submission
Submit the registration form
Verify the registration completes successfully
Verify the newly registered profile is created

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the admin username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}

Submit the login form
Click the link to the admin search area
Verify the admin search page is accessible
Verify search results or an empty state are displayed
